definitions.explanation: A pencil with a colored wax or pigment core, used for drawing, coloring, and marking. Usually sold in sets of various colors.

examples.japanese: {色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}で{絵|え}を{描|か}く。
examples.english: Draw a picture with colored pencils.

examples.japanese: {二十四色|にじゅうよんしょく}の{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}セットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a 24-color colored pencil set.

examples.japanese: {大人|おとな}{向|む}けの{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}が{人気|にんき}になり、{高級|こうきゅう}{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}の{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きも{伸|の}びている。
examples.english: Adult coloring books have become popular, and sales of high-end colored pencils are growing too.

notes:
Compound of {色|いろ} (color) + {鉛筆|えんぴつ} (pencil). Counted with the counter {本|ほん}: {一本|いっぽん} "one pencil."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}で{描|か}く: draw with colored pencils
- {色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}を{削|けず}る: sharpen a colored pencil
- {色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}セット: colored pencil set
- {十二色|じゅうにしょく}の{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}: a 12-color pencil set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- クレヨン: crayon — softer, waxier, broader strokes
- マーカー: marker — felt-tip, bold lines
- {水彩|すいさい}{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}: watercolor pencils — can be blended with water
